name: Core.InitsUpdatesComm
proof:
theorem InitsUpdatesComm
  {P : PureExpr} {σ σ' σ'' : SemanticStore P}
  {ks ks' : List P.Ident} {vs vs' : List P.Expr} :
  UpdateStates σ ks vs σ' →
  InitStates σ' ks' vs' σ'' →
  ∃ σ₁,
    σ₁ = (updatedStates σ ks' vs') ∧
    InitStates σ ks' vs' σ₁ ∧
    UpdateStates σ₁ ks vs σ'' := by
  intro hu hi
  let hn := UpdateStatesNotDefMonotone' (InitStatesNotDefined hi) hu
  have := InitStatesLength hi
  refine ⟨_, rfl, updatedStatesInit this hn $ InitStatesNodup hi, ?_⟩
  let := UpdateStatesLength hu
  cases InitStatesUpdated hi
  cases UpdateStatesUpdated hu
  unfold updatedStates
  rewrite [updatedStatesComm]
  exact updatedStatesUpdate this $ updatedStatesDefMonotone $ UpdateStatesDefined' hu
  simp_all [List.unzip_zip]
  intro x hx hx'
  cases hn x hx' ▸ UpdateStatesDefined' hu x hx

name: fundamental_theorem_of_variational_calculus'
proof:
lemma fundamental_theorem_of_variational_calculus' {f : Y → V}
    (μ : Measure Y) [IsFiniteMeasureOnCompacts μ] [μ.IsOpenPosMeasure]
    [OpensMeasurableSpace Y]
    (hf : Continuous f) (hg : ∀ g, IsTestFunction g → ∫ x, ⟪f x, g x⟫_ℝ ∂μ = 0) :
    f = 0 := by
  ext x₀
  by_contra hx
  have hp := real_inner_self_nonneg'.lt_of_ne' $ inner_self_eq_zero'.not.mpr hx
  have hc := hf.inner' (𝕜 := ℝ) f (λ_ => f x₀) continuous_const
  obtain ⟨φ, hs, hk, hd, hr, he⟩ := exists_contDiff_tsupport_subset
    (hc.continuousAt.preimage_mem_nhds $ Ici_mem_nhds hp)
  exact ((hd.continuous.mul hc).integral_pos_of_hasCompactSupport_nonneg_nonzero
    hk.mul_right (λx => if hx : φ x = 0 then (mul_eq_zero_of_left hx _).ge
      else mul_nonneg (hr $ Set.mem_range_self x).1 $ hs $ subset_closure hx)
    (mul_ne_zero (ne_zero_of_eq_one he) hp.ne')).ne' $ by
      simpa only [inner_smul_right', Pi.mul_apply] using hg _ $ (IsTestFunction.mk hd hk).smul_right contDiff_const

name: Electromagnetism.ElectromagneticPotential.time_deriv_time_deriv_electricField_of_isExtrema
proof:
lemma time_deriv_time_deriv_electricField_of_isExtrema {A : ElectromagneticPotential d}
    {𝓕 : FreeSpace}
    (hA : ContDiff ℝ ∞ A) (J : LorentzCurrentDensity d)
    (hJ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ J) (h : IsExtrema 𝓕 A J)
    (t : Time) (x : Space d) (i : Fin d) :
    ∂ₜ (∂ₜ (A.electricField 𝓕.c · x i)) t =
      𝓕.c ^ 2 * ∑ j, (∂[j] (∂[j] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · i)) x) -
      𝓕.c ^ 2 / 𝓕.ε₀ * ∂[i] (J.chargeDensity 𝓕.c t ·) x -
      𝓕.c ^ 2 * 𝓕.μ₀ * ∂ₜ (J.currentDensity 𝓕.c · x i) t := by
  have hJ1 := hJ.differentiable $ by simp
  have hA3 : ContDiff ℝ 3 A := hA.of_le ENat.LEInfty.out
  have hEs j := @electricField_apply_contDiff_space d j 2 A 𝓕.c hA3 t
  have hEd := λj => Space.deriv_differentiable $ hEs j
  have hB j := @magneticFieldMatrix_contDiff d 2 𝓕.c A hA3 (j, i)
  have hg := congrArg (λf => fderiv ℝ f x $ Space.basis i)
    (funext λy => ((isExtrema_iff_gauss_ampere_magneticFieldMatrix hA J hJ).mp h t y).1)
  unfold Space.div at hg


  conv_lhs =>
    enter [1, s]
    rw [Time.deriv_euclid $ electricField_differentiable_time
      hA3.of_succ _, time_deriv_electricField_of_isExtrema hA J hJ h]
  have hBt j := Space.space_deriv_differentiable_time (i := j) (hB j) x t
  have hJt := @LorentzCurrentDensity.currentDensity_apply_differentiable_time d 𝓕.c J hJ1 x i t
  simp (disch := fun_prop) only [div_eq_mul_inv, fderiv_fun_sum λj _ => (hEd j j).differentiableAt,
    fderiv_mul_const (LorentzCurrentDensity.chargeDensity_differentiable_space
      hJ1 t).differentiableAt, Time.deriv_eq, fderiv_fun_sub, fderiv_const_mul, fderiv_fun_sum, ContinuousLinearMap.sub_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply,
    smul_eq_mul, FunLike.coe_sum, Finset.sum_apply,
    ← Space.deriv_eq_fderiv_basis] at hg ⊢
  simp only [← Time.deriv_eq,
    λj => Space.time_deriv_comm_space_deriv (i := j) $ hB j,
    time_deriv_magneticFieldMatrix _ hA3.of_succ,
    Space.fun_deriv_sub _ _ (hEd i _) $ hEd _ i,
    λj => @Space.deriv_commute ℝ d j i _ _ _ $ hEs j,
    Finset.sum_sub_distrib, hg, FreeSpace.c_sq, mul_comm 𝓕.ε₀ 𝓕.μ₀, mul_inv_rev,
    div_eq_mul_inv, mul_sub, mul_assoc, inv_mul_cancel_left₀ 𝓕.μ₀_ne_zero, one_mul]

name: FieldSpecification.WickAlgebra.ι_timeOrderF_superCommuteF_eq_time
proof:
lemma ι_timeOrderF_superCommuteF_eq_time {φ ψ : 𝓕.CrAnFieldOp}
    (hφψ : crAnTimeOrderRel φ ψ) (hψφ : crAnTimeOrderRel ψ φ) (a b : 𝓕.FieldOpFreeAlgebra) :
    ι 𝓣ᶠ(a * [ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF * b) =
    ι ([ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF * 𝓣ᶠ(a * b)) := by
  let T := (ι (𝓕 := 𝓕)).toLinearMap.comp timeOrderF
  let C := [ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF
  let M := LinearMap.mul ℂ 𝓕.FieldOpFreeAlgebra
  apply LinearMap.congr_fun₂ (f := (M.comp $ LinearMap.mulRight ℂ C).compr₂ T)
    (g := M.compr₂ $ (LinearMap.mulLeft ℂ $ ι C).comp T)
  apply LinearMap.ext_basis ofCrAnListFBasis ofCrAnListFBasis
  intro u v
  dsimp [T, C, M]
  simp only [ofListBasis_eq_ofList]
  obtain ⟨L, R, s⟩ : ∃ L R, ∀ (l : List 𝓕.CrAnFieldOp)
      (hl : ∀ c ∈ l, crAnTimeOrderRel φ c ∧ crAnTimeOrderRel c φ :=
        by simp [hφψ, hψφ]),
      ofCrAnListF (crAnTimeOrderList $ u ++ (l ++ v)) =
        L * ofCrAnListF l * R := by
    refine ⟨?_ * ?_, ?_ * ?_, ?_⟩
    rotate_left 4
    intro l hl
    rw [crAnTimeOrderList, ← List.append_assoc, insertionSort_of_eq_list crAnTimeOrderRel φ u l v hl]
    simp only [ofCrAnListF_append, mul_assoc]
    exact rfl
  trans ι $ crAnTimeOrderSign (u ++ φ :: ψ :: v) • (L * C * R)
  · congr 1
    conv_lhs =>
      rw [superCommuteF_ofCrAnOpF_ofCrAnOpF]
      simp [mul_sub, sub_mul, ← ofCrAnListF_singleton, ← ofCrAnListF_append,
        timeOrderF_ofCrAnListF]
    erw [← crAnTimeOrderSign_swap_eq_time hφψ hψφ, s [φ, ψ], s [ψ, φ]]
    simp only [C, superCommuteF_ofCrAnOpF_ofCrAnOpF, ofCrAnListF_cons, ofCrAnListF_nil, one_mul,
      mul_sub, sub_mul, mul_smul_comm, smul_mul_assoc, mul_assoc]
    rw [smul_sub, smul_comm]
  · simp only [map_smul, map_mul]
    rw [Subalgebra.mem_center_iff.mp $ ι_superCommuteF_ofCrAnOpF_ofCrAnOpF_mem_center φ ψ,
      mul_assoc, ← map_mul]
    have h := s []
    simp only [List.nil_append, ofCrAnListF_nil, mul_one] at h
    rw [← h]
    by_cases hq : 𝓕.crAnStatistics ψ = 𝓕.crAnStatistics φ
    · rw [crAnTimeOrderSign, Wick.koszulSign_eq_rel_eq_stat _ _ hφψ hψφ hq,
        ← crAnTimeOrderSign, ← ofCrAnListF_append, timeOrderF_ofCrAnListF]
      simp only [map_smul, mul_smul_comm]
    · simp only [ι_superCommuteF_of_diff_statistic $ Ne.symm hq, zero_mul, smul_zero]

name: Cslib.SKI.parallelReduction_diamond
proof:
theorem parallelReduction_diamond : Diamond ParallelReduction := by
  intro a a₁ a₂ h₁ h₂
  induction h₁ generalizing a₂
  case refl => use a₂, h₂, ParallelReduction.refl _
  case' par ha hb iha ihb => skip
  all_goals cases h₂
  case par.par ha' hb' =>
    specialize iha ha'
    specialize ihb hb'
    exact ⟨_, iha.choose_spec.1.par ihb.choose_spec.1, iha.choose_spec.2.par ihb.choose_spec.2⟩
  case' par.red_I | par.red_K | par.red_S => apply symm
  case par.red_I | red_I.par ha hb =>
    cases ha
    exact ⟨_, hb, .red_I _⟩
  case par.red_K | red_K.par ha hc =>
    apply Ka_irreducible at ha
    exact ha.choose_spec.2.symm ▸ ⟨_, ha.choose_spec.1, .red_K ..⟩
  case par.red_S | red_S.par ha hb =>
    have := (Sab_irreducible _ _ _ ha).choose_spec.choose_spec
    apply this.2.2.symm.subst
    exact ⟨_, (this.1.par hb).par $ this.2.1.par hb, .red_S ..⟩
  all_goals
    refine ⟨_, .refl _, ?_⟩
    constructor <;> assumption

name: Cslib.CCS.bisimilarity_congr_choice
proof:
theorem bisimilarity_congr_choice :
    (p ~[lts (defs := defs)] q) → (choice p r) ~[lts (defs := defs)] (choice q r) := by
  intro h
  rewrite [HomBisimilarity.symm_simulation]
  exists _, ChoiceBisim.choice h
  constructor
  · constructor
    rintro _ _ ⟨⟩ <;> constructor <;> symm <;> assumption
  · rintro _ _ (h | h) μ s ht
    case' choice =>
      cases ht <;> rename_i ht
      case choiceR =>
        use s, Tr.choiceR ht
        constructor
        apply_rfl
    all_goals
      apply h.follow_fst at ht
      use ht.choose, ?_, ChoiceBisim.bisim ht.choose_spec.2
      try apply Tr.choiceL
      exact ht.choose_spec.1

name: Binius.BinaryBasefold.fiberwise_dist_lt_imp_dist_lt_unique_decoding_radius
proof:
theorem fiberwise_dist_lt_imp_dist_lt_unique_decoding_radius (i : Fin ℓ) (steps : ℕ)
    [NeZero steps] (h_i_add_steps : i.val + steps ≤ ℓ)
    (f : OracleFunction 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ⟨i, by omega⟩)
  (h_fw_dist_lt : fiberwiseClose 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    (i := i) (steps := steps) (h_i_add_steps := h_i_add_steps) (f := f)) :
  hammingClose 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ⟨i, by omega⟩ f := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨⟨g, hg⟩, hd⟩ := Nat.sInf_mem $ Set.range_nonempty
    (λg : BBF_Code 𝔽q β _ => (fiberwiseDisagreementSet 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps f g.1).ncard)
  apply (mul_le_mul_left' (Code.distFromCode_le_dist_to_mem f g hg) 2).trans_lt
  apply ENat.coe_lt_coe.2
  have hh := Nat.mul_le_mul_right (2 ^ steps) $ Nat.le_of_lt_succ $ ENat.coe_lt_coe.1 h_fw_dist_lt
  simp only [fiberwiseDistance, Set.image_univ, ←hd, Nat.mul_assoc, Nat.sub_mul,
    ←Nat.pow_add, ←Nat.sub_add_comm $ h_i_add_steps.trans $ Nat.le_add_right ..,
    ←Nat.sub_add_comm h_i_add_steps, Nat.add_sub_add_right] at hh
  apply Nat.lt_succ_of_le
  apply le_trans _ hh
  apply Nat.mul_le_mul_left 2
  simp only [Set.ncard_eq_toFinset_card', ←Finset.card_fin $ 2 ^ steps, ←Finset.card_product]
  apply Finset.card_le_card_of_surjOn λp => qMap_total_fiber 𝔽q β _ steps
    (Nat.lt_add_of_pos_right_of_le _ _ _ h_i_add_steps) p.1 p.2
  intro x hx
  refine ⟨(_, _), ?_, (is_fiber_iff_generates_quotient_point 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps x _).mp rfl⟩
  exact Finset.mem_product.mpr ⟨Set.mem_toFinset.mpr
    ⟨x, rfl, (Finset.mem_filter.mp hx).2⟩, Finset.mem_univ _⟩

name: Binius.BinaryBasefold.fold_advances_evaluation_poly
proof:
theorem fold_advances_evaluation_poly
  (i : Fin (ℓ)) (h_i_succ_lt : i + 1 < ℓ + 𝓡)
  (coeffs : Fin (2 ^ (ℓ - ↑i)) → L) (r_chal : L) :
  let P_i : L[X] := intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i, by
    exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := ℓ+1) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := i.isLt) (by exact Nat.lt_add_one ℓ)
  ⟩) coeffs
  let f_i := fun (x : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
      ⟨i, by exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := r) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := by omega) (by omega)⟩) =>
    P_i.eval (x.val : L)
  let f_i_plus_1 := fold (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (h_i := by omega) (f := f_i) (r_chal := r_chal)
  let new_coeffs := fun j : Fin (2^(ℓ - (i + 1))) =>
    (1 - r_chal) * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2, by
      rw [←Nat.add_zero (j.val * 2)]
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 0) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩) +
    r_chal * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2 + 1, by
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 1) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩)
  let P_i_plus_1 :=
    intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i+1, by omega⟩) new_coeffs
  ∀ (y : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    ⟨i+1, by omega⟩), f_i_plus_1 y = P_i_plus_1.eval y.val := λy => by
  have h_eval_qMap k :=
    Subtype.ext_iff.mp (generates_quotient_point_if_is_fiber_of_y 𝔽q β i 1 i.2
      _ y ⟨k, rfl⟩).symm
  unfold fold
  simp_all only [iteratedQuotientMap_k_eq_1_is_qMap, evaluation_poly_split_identity, Polynomial.eval_add, eval_comp, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_X]
  simp only [qMap_total_fiber_one_level_eq 𝔽q β i i.2, Fin2ToF2, one_ne_zero, ↓reduceIte, one_smul, Submodule.coe_add,
    get_sDomain_first_basis_eq_1, zero_smul, zero_add, evenRefinement, oddRefinement, intermediateEvaluationPoly,
    Polynomial.eval_finset_sum, Polynomial.eval_C_mul, Finset.mul_sum,
    Finset.sum_mul, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intros
  ring1

name: interleaved_affine_gaps_imply_tensor_gaps
proof:
theorem interleaved_affine_gaps_imply_tensor_gaps
    (hC_proximityGapAffineLines : e_ε_correlatedAgreementAffineLinesNat
      (F := F) (A := A) (ι := ι) (C := MC) (e := e) (ε := ε))
    (h_interleaved_gaps : ∀ m : ℕ, m ≥ 1 →
      e_ε_correlatedAgreementAffineLinesNat (F := F)
        (A := InterleavedSymbol A (Fin m)) (ι := ι) (C := MC ^⋈ (Fin m)) e ε) :
    ∀ (ϑ : ℕ), (hϑ_gt_0 : ϑ > 0) → δ_ε_multilinearCorrelatedAgreement_Nat (F := F) (A := A)
      (ι := ι) (C := MC) (ϑ := ϑ) (e := e) (ε := ε) := by
  apply Nat.le_induction
  · intro u hp
    rewrite [show u = finMapTwoWords (u 0) (u 1) from funext (Fin.forall_fin_two.2 ⟨rfl, rfl⟩)]
    apply hC_proximityGapAffineLines
    rewrite [← @prob_uniform_singleton_finFun_eq F _ ⟨0⟩]
    simpa only [multilinearCombine₁_eq_affineLineEvaluation,
      Nat.cast_one, ENNReal.coe_one, one_mul, ENNReal.coe_natCast] using hp
  · intro n hn ih u hp
    apply CA_split_rowwise_implies_CA _ u
    apply h_interleaved_gaps _ Nat.one_le_two_pow
    refine lt_of_le_of_lt' ?_ $ prob_R_star_gt_threshold MC u e ?_
    · apply Pr_le_Pr_of_implies
      intro r hmem
      exact correlatedAgreement_of_mem_R_star_tensor MC ih u ⟨r, hmem⟩
    · simp only [← prob_split_last_uniform_sampling_of_finFun,
        multilinearCombine_affineComb_split_last_close, ← Fin.init_def,
        ← multilinearCombine_recursive_form, ENNReal.coe_mul]
      exact hp

name: putnam_1964_a4
proof:
theorem putnam_1964_a4
(u : ℕ → ℤ)
(boundedu : ∃ B T : ℤ, ∀ n : ℕ, B ≤ u n ∧ u n ≤ T)
(hu : ∀ n ≥ 4, u n = ((u (n - 1) + u (n - 2) + u (n - 3) * u (n - 4)) : ℝ) / (u (n - 1) * u (n - 2) + u (n - 3) + u (n - 4)) ∧ (u (n - 1) * u (n - 2) + u (n - 3) + u (n - 4)) ≠ 0)
: (∃ N c : ℕ, c > 0 ∧ ∀ n ≥ N, u (n + c) = u n) := by
  obtain ⟨B, T, hB⟩ := boundedu
  obtain ⟨i, j, hij, heq⟩ := (Set.Finite.pi λ_ : Fin 4 => Set.finite_Icc B T).exists_lt_map_eq_of_forall_mem $ by intro n k _; exact hB $ n + k
  have :=  @Nat.strongRec _ λm ih => by
    by_cases hm : m < 4
    · simpa using congrFun heq.symm ⟨m, hm⟩
    · clear hij
      rify
      simp (disch := omega) only [hu, Nat.add_sub_assoc, ih]
  use i, j - i, Nat.sub_pos_of_lt hij
  intro n hn
  convert this $ n - i using 2 <;> omega

name: putnam_1964_b2
proof:
theorem putnam_1964_b2
(S : Type*) [Fintype S] [Nonempty S]
(P : Finset (Set S))
(hPP : ∀ T ∈ P, ∀ U ∈ P, T ∩ U ≠ ∅)
(hPS : ¬∃ T : Set S, T ∉ P ∧ (∀ U ∈ P, T ∩ U ≠ ∅))
: (P.card = 2 ^ (Fintype.card S - 1)) := by
  classical
  suffices Pᶜ.card = P.card by
    rw [Finset.card_compl, Fintype.card_set, ← mul_pow_sub_one NeZero.out] at this
    omega
  apply Finset.card_equiv compl_involutive.toPerm
  simp
  grind

name: putnam_1995_a3
proof:
theorem putnam_1995_a3
(relation : (Fin 9 → ℤ) → (Fin 9 → ℤ) → Prop)
(digits_to_num : (Fin 9 → ℤ) → ℤ)
(hdigits_to_num : digits_to_num = fun dig => ∑ i : Fin 9, (dig i) * 10^i.1)
(hrelation : ∀ d e : (Fin 9 → ℤ), relation d e ↔ (∀ i : Fin 9, d i < 10 ∧ d i ≥ 0 ∧ e i < 10 ∧ e i ≥ 0) ∧ (∀ i : Fin 9, 7 ∣ (digits_to_num (fun j : Fin 9 => if j = i then e j else d j))))
: ∀ d e f : (Fin 9 → ℤ), ((relation d e) ∧ (relation e f)) → (∀ i : Fin 9, 7 ∣ d i - f i) := by
  have replace (a b : _ → _) i :
      digits_to_num (λj => if j = i then b j else a j) =
        digits_to_num a + (b i * 10^i.1 - a i * 10^i.1) := by
    apply eq_add_of_sub_eq'
    simp only [hdigits_to_num, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib,
      ite_mul, ite_sub, sub_self, Fintype.sum_ite_eq']
  intro d e f h i
  simp only [hrelation, replace] at h
  choose k hk using h.1.2
  choose l hl using h.2.2
  apply (show IsCoprime (7 : ℤ) 10 by decide).pow_right |>.dvd_of_dvd_mul_right
  refine ⟨(∑ j, k j) - digits_to_num d - k i - l i, ?_⟩
  simp only [mul_sub, Finset.mul_sum, ← hk, ← hl i, Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_sub_distrib,
    Fin.sum_const, Int.nsmul_eq_mul]
  rw [hdigits_to_num]
  ring1
